description: Replacing a legacy release marker. When the existing changelog begins with a free-form legacy header that ends in an old-style release anchor marker, generating a new release strips the legacy header text but retains everything from the old release anchor onward, prepending the freshly generated section above it. Input describes a release run over a changelog seeded with legacy header text plus an old release anchor; output is the new section followed by the preserved legacy anchor block.

cases.expected_output:
# Release Notes
### [1.0.1](/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (DATE)


### Bug Fixes

* patch release HASH



<a name=1.0.0>
